verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a fair axis for a backend platform with a web console, but the evidence never shows one inside Appwrite. What it documents instead are external integrations: an MCP server, skills, and plugins that let third-party agents such as Claude Code, Codex and Cursor operate on a project, plus AI building blocks for apps (image labeling, vector search). Those are adjacent capabilities and developer primitives, not an in-product assistant you can delegate tasks to.
